title: Passwords and two-factor authentication, made simple

posts.facebook:
You don't need a memory for passwords. You need one strong one for email, three random words, and a phone that remembers the rest.

Why reusing one password is the real risk, how to build one from three random words, why saving passwords on your own phone is fine, what two-factor authentication actually does and how to turn it on, and what to do if your details turn up in a data breach.

Give your email its own three-random-words password, let your phone save the others, and turn on two-step verification for email and banking.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/tech/passwords-and-two-factor-made-simple/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
